units.source_text: 且说今年十一月间的五节舞会，源氏太政大臣家须遣送舞姬一人。

en.t: Now, for the Gosechi dance festival to be held this November, the household of Genji, the Grand Minister, had to send one dancing girl.

units.source_text: 此事并不十分烦忙，只是日子近了，随从舞姬的童女等人的服装，必须赶紧置办。

en.t: The matter was not especially burdensome, but as the day drew near, the costumes for the young attendants and others who would accompany the dancer had to be prepared in haste.

units.source_text: 住在东院的花散里，司理舞姬入宫时随从人等所穿的服装。

en.t: Hanachirusato, who lived in the eastern wing, managed the clothing to be worn by the attendants when the dancer entered the palace.
Genji himself oversaw the general arrangements.

units.source_text: 新立的秋好皇后也相帮置办了许多华丽的服饰，连童女和下级差役的衣衫也齐备。

en.t: The newly installed Empress Akikonomu also helped prepare many splendid garments, and even the clothes for the young girls and lower-ranking attendants were all made ready.

units.source_text: 去年因有藤壶母后之丧，五节舞会停止举行。

en.t: Last year, because of the mourning for the Empress Mother Fujitsubo, the Gosechi dance festival had been canceled.

units.source_text: 为了补偿去年的寂寞，今年人心特别兴奋。

en.t: As if to make up for the quietness of the previous year, everyone was especially excited this year.

units.source_text: 在选送舞姬时，各家竭力竞争，一切务求尽善尽美。

en.t: When selecting and presenting dancers, each household competed with all its strength, striving to make every detail perfect.

units.source_text: 云居雁的后父按察大纳言和内大臣之弟左卫门督，都把女儿送去当舞姬。

en.t: Kumoinokari's stepfather, the Azechi Dainagon, and the Minister of the Interior's younger brother, the Commander of the Left Gate Guards, both sent daughters to serve as dancers.

units.source_text: 地方官方面，现任近江守兼左中弁的良清也遣送一个女儿。

en.t: Among the provincial officials, Yoshikiyo, currently Governor of Omi and also Left Middle Controller, sent one of his daughters as well.

units.source_text: 今年特定规章：凡舞姬于会毕后皆得留住宫中，充当女官。

en.t: This year a special rule had been established: after the festival, all the dancers could remain in the palace and serve as court ladies.

units.source_text: 因此大家愿意遣送女儿。

en.t: For that reason, people were eager to send their daughters.
